summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of brook.ie MVP. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (register/login/me/update), catalog, feed (foryou/following/nearby), post CRUD, like/save/comment (with reply), follows, professional onboarding/profile/analytics, tag flow (create -> respond -> pro details), find-a-pro ranking (score ordering + reasons), professional search, collections CRUD with save-to-collection, search, notifications, reports, booking-click analytics, admin gating (403 for non-admin, all admin endpoints reachable for admin). Frontend: welcome/login flow works; customer maya lands in tabs (Home, Discover, Saved, Profile) with feed images, category chips, recommended pros; post detail loads with Find-a-Pro CTA which navigates to /find-pro/[id] showing ranked pros (Best match, Exact match, Style match, distance, starting price); professional public page /professional/braidsbykay renders with Portfolio/Services/Book Appointment; notifications populate; Kay's Pro Studio dashboard (dashboard/analytics/edit) works; admin overview with counts works. All auth, discovery, and pro flows are functional end-to-end.

minor.issue: Endpoint is unauthenticated (Optional viewer) - can be spammed to inflate professional's booking-clicks analytics counter
Publicly accessible with no auth - by design for image serving but any UUID path guess could enumerate uploads; consider signed URLs
Uses full PostIn body so caller must resend media/all fields even for a caption edit - not truly a PATCH

ui_bugs.issue: 'Find Someone Who Can Do This' CTA and comment input lack testID attributes (post-find-pro, post-comment). Only post-like and post-save are wired.

Navigating to /professional (no id) returns Expo Router 'Unmatched Route'. Either add an index redirect to /professional/dashboard or ensure nothing links there. Reference: /app/frontend/app/professional/

issues: Seed image quality: several posts use stock photos that do not represent the beauty content - e.g. 'Knotless Braids' by @hairbyjane uses a photo of a woman by the ocean (no braids visible); 'Wispy Cat Eye - Volume' by @lashedbylexi uses a photo of a wooden A-frame building. This breaks the discovery experience since users cannot recognize the look. Curate beauty-specific seed images (see /app/backend/seed.py).
Professional cover on braidsbykay page is a salon interior which is fine, but portfolio thumbnails inherit the same off-topic sky/water image from her Fulani Braids post.

react_native_issues.issue: Icon names 'eyebrow' and 'sparkles' are not valid @expo/vector-icons material-community names - console emits repeated warnings on every render (Home, Discover). Use valid MCI names (e.g. 'eye-outline', 'star-four-points') or switch to Ionicons for these. Reference: seed data category icons in /app/backend/seed.py and their consumer in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (category chips).

React Native web logs: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Repeatedly in console. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow for web or gate them behind Platform.OS !== 'web'.
React Native web warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents into style prop.

action_items: Curate beauty-relevant seed images in /app/backend/seed.py (currently posts show unrelated landscape/architecture stock photos) and re-run seed.
Replace invalid material-community icon names ('eyebrow', 'sparkles') in seeded categories or map them client-side to valid icons.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (or wrap in Platform.select) and move pointerEvents into style prop to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.
Add testIDs to 'Find Someone Who Can Do This' button and comment input on post detail screen (post-find-pro, post-comment).
Add /app/frontend/app/professional/index.tsx that redirects to /(tabs)/profile or /professional/dashboard to avoid Unmatched Route.
Consider requiring auth on POST /api/analytics/booking-click to prevent spam of analytics counters.
Change PUT /api/posts/{id} to a partial update model so caption edits don't require resending media/attributes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1096 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, posts, professional, admin, catalog) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

public_user() leaks the user's email to any caller of GET /api/users/{id} - this exposes PII of every user to any authenticated (or anon, with is_following=False path) requester. Remove 'email' from public_user() for non-self responses.

professional/onboard allows the caller to choose their pro username with no rate limiting or reservation of the personal @username; username collisions are checked but consider a global namespace across users+professionals.
find_professionals uses N+1 queries (per-pro post_count, aggregate for engagement). Fine for seeded 5 pros but will become slow; add caching or single aggregation pipeline.
No pagination on /posts/feed, /saved, /collections/{id}/posts, /notifications - hardcoded limits (40-500). Add cursor-based pagination.
JWT expiry is 43,200 minutes (30 days) - long-lived; consider shorter access token + refresh token.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% - all core flows navigate & render; minor missing testIDs + seed image quality issues + RN deprecation warnings

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Registered a couple of TEST_ throwaway accounts inside pytest (test_register_and_me, test_onboard_new_pro, TEST Salon pro) - not cleaned up; recommend re-running seed.py if a clean state is desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend routes verified: /welcome, /login, /register, /(tabs)/index, /(tabs)/discover, /(tabs)/saved, /(tabs)/profile, /post/[id], /find-pro/[postId], /professional/[id|username], /professional/dashboard, /professional/analytics, /notifications, /admin. /professional (no id) is an Unmatched Route. Login credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md are valid. If retesting after image/icon fixes, focus on Home feed visuals and category chip icons.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no blocking bugs. Findings are seed data quality, missing testIDs, missing /professional index route, and standard RN Web deprecation warnings, plus a PII leak (email in public_user) worth addressing.
